scripts.generate: rm -rf src && mkdir -p src && protoc --proto_path=../../proto --es_out=target=ts,import_extension=.js:src --connect-es_out=target=ts,import_extension=.js:src assay/v1/service.proto assay/v1/primitive.proto
scripts.test: npm run generate && npm run check && npm run build && node --input-type=module -e 'import("./dist/service_connect.js").then(({ DataService, StudyService, RunService }) => { if (DataService.methods.ensureData.kind !== 1 || StudyService.methods.run.kind !== 1 || RunService.methods.compare.kind !== 0) throw new Error("generated service descriptors are incomplete"); })'
